# The `snes-room` ES-DE fixture

A placeholder of I3 step 0a, which settles the folder; I3 step 1c builds the fixture, its `files.json` payloads and
this README's layout and counts, which tests assert.

The room of G02 and G10 (docs/roadmap.md, I3): one cartridge system whose full name is invented (no trademarked name in
any committed image), 50 invented titles plus the 10 that G10 adds after a first plan, with generated covers (an
original procedural picture with the title, landscape and one portrait; PNG and JPEG) and clips (4:3, from
`media::test_video`): a corrupt clip and a missing one, two titles with a USA and a Europe release, a game without a
cover. Nothing commercial: no real title, system name or cover. Covers and clips are generated when the fixture is
materialized, never committed.
